column1: # Ash Jenna, an antagonist, confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3: There you are, Isaac.\nI was starting to think\nyou would never come.{end_wait}
Jenna? What happened to\nyou? You are grey...\nCome back with us.{end_wait}
Come back? The fire took\neverything soft in me.{page_break}What is left is ash,\nand ash remembers.{end_wait}
Jenna, this is not you!\nSnap out of it!{end_wait}
Poor Garet. Always the\nloud one.{page_break}Be quiet. Burn quietly.{end_wait}
An ash girl with a\ngrudge. How tedious.\nKnow your place.{end_wait}
Mia. The blade's\ndaughter. We are the same.{page_break}The light made us\nboth.{end_wait}

Light the next one,
Isaac. Every flame you
kindle feeds me.{page_break}I will be waiting at the
top. All of you will
be dust.{end_wait}
